headline.partition_sensitivity_caveat: within a draw the predicted and realised ratios share the pre-update FPR and the threshold, so their errors are correlated and the within-draw slope is pulled toward the shared-denominator slope (about 1 on the log scale); it is a partition sensitivity only (D-166, correcting D-163 (1)); applies to every 'partition_sensitivity_within_draw' field

In 'partition_sensitivity_within_draw' the 'frozen' value, its frozen_percentile and n_cells_floored_frozen_split belong to the frozen split, which is NOT a cluster-level draw (it splits 36 of 67 Aegis and 7 of 11 WildGuardMix clusters)
